clientFunction.name: get_vendor_breakdown
clientFunction.description: Return one month's totals and last 3 charges for a vendor. The vendor argument is matched case-insensitively as a SUBSTRING against transaction vendor names, so 'Tesco' matches both 'Tesco' and 'Tesco Express' (their totals are summed). Use this when the customer asks about a specific vendor — 'what have I spent at Tesco?', 'how much on Pret this month?'. Returns { matched_vendors:[…], month_label, total, count, recent:[{days_ago,amount}] }. An empty matched_vendors list with total=0 is a valid result — say plainly that you don't see any transactions for that vendor; do NOT treat it as an error. Pass show=true when the customer asked to SEE the vendor history ("show me my Pret habit"): the app navigates to spending and surfaces the vendor-history view.

vendor.description: Required. The vendor name as the customer said it. Matched case-insensitively as a substring.

month.description: Optional. 0 = current month (default), 1 = last month, 2 = two months ago.

show.description: Optional. When true, the app also navigates to the spending page and surfaces the vendor-history view. Use when the customer asked to SEE; omit (or false) for pure data lookups like 'how much have I spent at Tesco?'.
